search_text: published ZDI-15-299 ZDI-CAN-2582 Samsung SyncThru FileUploadController Directory Traversal Remote Code Execution Vulnerability 2015-07-13 CVE-2015-5473 https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2015-5473 10.0 AV:N/AC:L/Au:N/C:C/I:C/A:C ['Samsung'] ['SyncThru'] This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on vulnerable installations of Samsung SyncThru. By default, authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the FileUploadController servlet exposed by uploadFirmware.html. The issue lies in the failure to sanitize the path of files uploaded, allowing for them to be placed anywhere on the server. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute arbitrary code as SYSTEM. Resolved by: Samsung SyncThu 6 v1.0 ['2015-05-27 - Vulnerability reported to vendor', '2015-07-13 - Coordinated public release of advisory'] Andrea Micalizzi (rgod) https://www.zerodayinitiative.com/advisories/ZDI-15-299/
title: Samsung SyncThru FileUploadController Directory Traversal Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on vulnerable installations of Samsung SyncThru. By default, authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the FileUploadController servlet exposed by uploadFirmware.html. The issue lies in the failure to sanitize the path of files uploaded, allowing for them to be placed anywhere on the server. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute arbitrary code as SYSTEM.
